A little street sense

Three rides. Get home.

The other passengers hold the doorway. They will not chase you around or board themselves. Knock down the marked rival, then fight or shove the blockers aside and enter through the gap. Win all three stops to complete the home run. A trotro may arrive full. Let it leave, collect supplies, and wait for the next arrival. Missing one bus keeps the run going until service ends. Your score, health, and equipped weapon carry forward, with 25 health recovered between rides.

W A S D / ↑ ↓ ← →Move through the arena
JStrike the nearest rival. Tap or hold. Every third hit knocks them back.
FPower shove. Push blockers out of the doorway. Recharges in 4 seconds.
QCrowd Breaker. Charge with combos, knockdowns, perfect blocks and dodges. Unleash a wide knockback and four seconds of extra power.
K · holdBlock incoming hits. Time your guard for a perfect block.
L / SpaceDodge in your movement direction.
REquip a nearby weapon or drink for +30 health. A new weapon replaces the one you carry.
E · holdEnter after the doorway rival is down and a gap is open. Taking a hit interrupts you.
Esc / PPause and take a breath.
Choose your advantageTravel bag Wide swing · hits 2Umbrella Longest reach · light jabsBaton Fast strikes · low staminaMarket stool Heavy sweep · hits 3Suitcase Strong knockback · hits 2

Complete the timed stop challenge for +300 points and +15 health. Keep landing hits for a score multiplier up to ×3. Taking an unblocked hit or waiting too long breaks the streak. An orange ring means a rival is about to swing. A large red ring warns of a heavy sweep: dodge it. Dodge, then strike while they recover. Blockers return to their posts after recovering. Use the gap before they regroup.

 Fight for Trotro

Accra’s rush.
Turned up to eleven.

A busy trotro stop with a waiting queue, marked boarding bays and passing traffic. A fictional scramble for the last seat. Short rounds, readable combat, everyday objects, and the unmistakable energy of trying to get home.

Feel the fight

Five weapon pickups with different reach, speed, stamina costs, and crowd control. Combo finishers, blocks, and timed dodges.

Know your city

Six location-inspired arenas, built for the game. The layouts are creative interpretations.

Make the escape

Win three rides. Drop the doorway rival, shove blockers aside, and hold Board to enter.

Character and surface art

Human models and motion from Microsoft Rocketbox. Asphalt by Rob Tuytel / Poly Haven.

Google Maps links open the real locations for exploration. Street View imagery is not included in these arenas.
